if_joint_p_ge_0_05.interpretation: An additive process combining transferable species rainfall sensitivity, prior local species x SiteID memory and focal dry-state persistence is sufficient under the tested null family. Do not add a species x site rainfall-interaction model unless a reviewer identifies a specific inferential defect.

if_joint_p_lt_0_05.next_question: Does rainfall preferentially activate historically likely species x SiteID cells beyond their baseline local-memory probability?
next_model_constraints: Estimate the rain x local-memory interaction only on routes in the opposite training fold.
Use strictly-prior focal-pair local memory in held-out routes.
Retain the already fixed cross-fit species shifts and a=0.75 dry persistence.
One global memory-gating coefficient is allowed; no species-specific site interaction coefficients.
Use the same four-component Mahalanobis null test with 1,000 simulations.
if_joint_p_lt_0_05.stop_rule: If this held-out memory-gating null is still rejected, stop and conclude that the available observational data identify structured state dependence but do not resolve a unique lower-level mechanism.

prohibited: No trait fishing after the joint-null result.
No arbitrary site-specific rainfall coefficients learned and tested on the same routes.
No relaxation of earlier failed gates.
No RC11 manuscript modification from this exploratory branch.
